text:
Hello!

My name is Bogdan Penkovsky.

I am passionate about two things: intelligence in general and optical computing. Recently I have become available for hire. What would you possibly suggest?

Some of my useful skills including but not limited to are recording and analyzing EEG for brain-computer interfaces, dynamical systems, digital electronics, FPGA, embedded systems; artificial neural networks, reservoir computing, and software (multiple programming languages). I also like autonomous cars and build them in my spare time.

Here is more about me: <https://penkovsky.com>

Cheers
